dialogueLines.line: Like, you take rapping really seriously, huh?
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: A dog thinks he can rap? How laughable.
dialogueLines.speaker: senpai

dialogueLines.line: Zoinks! Calm down, it's just a song.
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: Be silent, mutt. The stage is mine.
dialogueLines.speaker: senpai

dialogueLines.line: Like, why are you so angry at a dog?
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: You are beneath my notice, canine.
dialogueLines.speaker: senpai

dialogueLines.line: Zoinks! Your hair is... something else.
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: I will crush you like I crush all challengers.
